gaps.reference: Corpus-wide broken file-path references across docs/ (mu-bloodmoon-v1) and D:\MU\docs
gaps.detail: RESOLVES Part S (the previously twice-deferred exhaustive corpus audit): built and ran a real, mechanical scanner (scripts/knowledge-provenance-audit.mjs) over all .md files in both docs/ trees, extracting every file-path-shaped token (Research/, knowledge/, docs/, apps/, scripts/, references/, Tools/, catalog/ -- deliberately excluding Data/, which is an established shorthand for remote-VPS paths, not local files, and produces near-100% false positives if checked locally) and verifying each one resolves to a real file. Found 463 checkable references; 449 (97%) resolved correctly once the checker was fixed to also resolve relative to the mu-bloodmoon-v1/ repo root (an early version of this script had a real bug here, caught by its own results looking implausible -- apps/api/src/app.module.ts, a core file, was flagging as 'missing'). Of the 14 remaining candidates, ~5 are likely regex false positives (an ellipsis '...' in prose matched as part of a path; 4 references inside docs/agent-runtime/CODEX_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md are almost certainly to Claude Code's own product documentation, not a local file). 9 are CONFIRMED real gaps (spot-checked 4 directly): docs/game-data/phase-2a-real-sql-report.md (referenced, does not exist), scripts/build-figma-asset-manifest.mjs (referenced, does not exist), docs/protocols/destructive-actions.md (referenced, does not exist), apps/api/src/main.js (should be main.ts -- a stale extension in the doc), plus 2 mock-data file references in docs/handoff/community-current-state.md, and a couple more in docs/source-map.md pointing at a Research/20260722/ decompiled-source snapshot that may have been cleaned up since that doc was written.
gaps.followUp: None of these 9 gaps block current work -- they're all references FROM other docs TO missing targets, not missing RAW for this sweep's own subject matter. Left for the doc owners to fix or for a future pass to either restore/re-point the references. Full machine-readable output available by re-running `node scripts/knowledge-provenance-audit.mjs --json`.

coverageNote: This sweep covers the YouTube dimension (Parts G-K) essentially completely for the 2 named target channels. Part S's corpus-wide audit (GAP-006) is now genuinely complete for file-path-shaped references (463 checked mechanically, not by keyword-matching prose) -- this is real exhaustive coverage of ONE dimension (broken links), not of every possible provenance-gap type. It still does not (and a single automated pass realistically cannot) catch 'summary without raw' or 'claim without a named source' where the doc's prose never names a concrete file path -- that class of gap would require a human or LLM close-read of all 75+ docs' actual content, not just their citations, which remains future work if ever judged worth the cost relative to its value.
